title: FBI reportedly investigating suspected intrusion into its NCIC law-enforcement database
date_note: Earliest page read (Muhalif, citing DHA) is published 21 November; the page gives no earlier day.
geo_basis: FBI headquarters; the sources name no city for the intrusion
summary: Turkish outlets Muhalif (citing DHA and unnamed sources) and DonanimHaber (citing ABC News) report a suspected cyber intrusion into the FBI's National Crime Information Center (NCIC). DonanimHaber says President Trump confirmed the attack in a Fox News phone interview and that the FBI declined to comment. DonanimHaber says who was behind it and how much data was accessed are unknown; Muhalif says the scope is still being reviewed.
plain: Turkish news reports say the FBI is looking into a suspected hack of NCIC, the database police agencies share. The FBI declined to comment, and the reports say the extent is not yet known.
exec: Reports say a database shared by federal, state and local police may have been hit; the extent is not yet known.

validation.note: Two Turkish outlets read (DonanimHaber, Muhalif); both relay unnamed US sources (ABC News, DHA), so one underlying report. The FBI, ABC and Fox pages were not read; no English or official page found.

review.note: duplicate: same NCIC event as earlier fbi-ncic-apparent-breach-2026-11; sources merged there, duplicate_of set; also attribution of unknown extent and attacker fixed
